eyebrow.zh: 来源记忆 · 内容指纹

headline.zh:
记住那句话，
也记住它来自哪里。
headline.en:
Remember the statement.
Keep its source attached.

sub.zh: SuJi 将抽取的事实、来源地址和捕获时的内容指纹保存在 SQLite，提供关键词回查，并在重新校验发现来源变化时标记旧事实失效。
sub.en: SuJi stores extracted facts, source addresses and capture-time fingerprints in SQLite, supports keyword lookup, and marks old facts stale when a recheck detects source changes.

caption.zh: 留下事实，也留下它的出处
caption.en: Keep the fact and the source it came from.

body.zh: 地址、应用标签和捕获指纹伴随事实保存。
body.en: Addresses, application labels and fingerprints are stored with facts.

body.zh: 重新校验发现内容变化时保存新旧 diff。
body.en: A detected source change retains its old/new diff.

body.zh: 规则抽取器支持本地文件示例，不需要模型服务。
body.en: The rule extractor supports a local-file example without a model service.

title.zh: 留下事实，也留下它的出处
title.en: Keep the fact and the source it came from.

body.zh: 笔记里的数字可能还在，出处却已被修改。事实和来源放在一起，复核时就能看到当时来自哪个文件或页面，以及后来哪些内容发生变化。fresh/stale 是来源版本状态，不表示陈述已经被验证为真或假。
body.en: A number can remain in your notes after its source changes. Keeping facts with their origin lets you inspect the file or page they came from and what changed later. fresh/stale describes source-version state, not whether a statement has been proven true or false.

body.zh: 构造文本包含“12 个任务”和“版本号是 1.0”两条事实。编辑任务数为 15 后，真实 FileFetcher 重读来源，Cascade 标记两条旧事实 stale，并保留含 12/15 的 diff。没有改动的版本号事实也失效，因为当前规则按整个来源指纹处理。
body.en: Constructed text contains two facts: twelve tasks and version 1.0. After changing the task count to fifteen, the real FileFetcher rereads the source and Cascade marks both old facts stale, retaining a diff with 12/15. The unchanged version fact also becomes stale because the current rule operates on the whole-source fingerprint.

body.zh: Capturer 提供文本与来源标签，FactExtractor 提取陈述，ingest_capture 写入来源与事实表。provenance 规范化内容后计算 SHA-256；Cascade 用文件、URL 或 doc_id fetcher 重新读取，再将旧指纹事实标为 stale 并保存 diff。macOS 菜单栏是可选的 Accessibility 捕获入口，CLI 可以无界面使用。
body.en: A Capturer supplies text and source labels, a FactExtractor produces statements, and ingest_capture stores sources and facts. provenance normalizes content before SHA-256 hashing. Cascade rereads file, URL or doc_id sources, marks old-fingerprint facts stale and stores a diff. The optional macOS menu bar provides Accessibility capture; the CLI can run headlessly.

body.zh: SuJi 将抽取的事实、来源地址和捕获时的内容指纹保存在 SQLite，提供关键词回查，并在重新校验发现来源变化时标记旧事实失效。
body.en: SuJi stores extracted facts, source addresses and capture-time fingerprints in SQLite, supports keyword lookup, and marks old facts stale when a recheck detects source changes.

body.zh: 失效是整个来源版本级别，不是逐句真假判断或完整语义依赖分析。
body.en: Invalidation is source-version based, not a per-statement truth judgment or complete semantic dependency analysis.

note.zh: v0.1.0 的真实文件捕获接口、规则抽取、SQLite 与重新校验。没有读取屏幕、访问 URL 或调用模型；临时目录自动清理。
note.en: Real v0.1.0 file-capture interface, rule extraction, SQLite and rechecking. No screen is read, URL fetched or model called; temporary files are cleaned up.

body.zh: 构造文本包含“12 个任务”和“版本号是 1.0”两条事实。编辑任务数为 15 后，真实 FileFetcher 重读来源，Cascade 标记两条旧事实 stale，并保留含 12/15 的 diff。没有改动的版本号事实也失效，因为当前规则按整个来源指纹处理。
body.en: Constructed text contains two facts: twelve tasks and version 1.0. After changing the task count to fifteen, the real FileFetcher rereads the source and Cascade marks both old facts stale, retaining a diff with 12/15. The unchanged version fact also becomes stale because the current rule operates on the whole-source fingerprint.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。基本示例只使用本地文件、规则抽取和 SQLite，不需要 Mac、Ollama 或辅助功能权限。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. The basic example uses local files, rule extraction and SQLite; it needs no Mac, Ollama or Accessibility permission.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/suji.git
cd suji
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 失效是整个来源版本级别，不是逐句真假判断或完整语义依赖分析。
limitations.en: Invalidation is source-version based, not a per-statement truth judgment or complete semantic dependency analysis.

limitations.zh: 本轮未验证屏幕权限、实际 App、URL 表示差异或模型抽取质量。
limitations.en: This example does not validate screen permissions, real apps, URL representation differences or model extraction quality.
